##### Project general facts

Toledo is the second phase of Bloom Living, a fully integrated and all-inclusive community featuring a collection of villas designed to offer residents a truly fulfilling lifestyle. This exceptional development is inspired by Mediterranean aesthetics, with residential areas interwoven with landscaped parks and a huge lake at its heart that acts as an important point of connectivity. The community features pathways linking to all amenities, creating a seamless and harmonious living environment.

Residents benefit from a wide range of facilities just within a short walking distance, including a main Clubhouse with easy access to pools, sports, recreational facilities, and a wellness center. The Town Center offers an array of retail and dining options, while the Community Center features two swimming pools and two children's play areas surrounded by lush greenery. A mosque and two outstanding international schools are also within easy reach by foot or bicycle, promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

Each residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The thoughtfully designed interiors maximize comfort and style, while equipped kitchens ensure effortless culinary experiences. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home environment that residents will love.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Zayed City, an all-inclusive, fully integrated community where true happiness lies in a balanced lifestyle and deep connections thrive. The area is ideal for those seeking a peaceful life, where residents can enjoy an active lifestyle while supporting the environment through social activities or simply riding a bike to school. Dedicated community centers serve each residential cluster, providing daily invitations for residents to connect in breathtaking settings.

The community offers an unrivaled host of amenities spanning pools, recreational zones, and safe play areas for children, all surrounded by lush greenery. Residents can enjoy a signature selection of artisanal cafés and world-class restaurants, with limitless retail and dining possibilities at the Town Centre without ever leaving the community. The multi-generational community fosters timeless experiences and moments with family and loved ones in unique settings.

The area's strategic positioning ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations throughout Abu Dhabi, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking convenience and quality of life. The community's thoughtful planning and extensive amenities create a pleasant environment perfect for living, resting, and unwinding. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of suburban tranquility, comprehensive amenities, and excellent connectivity, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Abu Dhabi's most desirable communities.
